entries.statement: NASA decided to keep Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams on the ISS and return Starliner to Earth uncrewed.
Engineering teams completed helium‑leak analysis, propulsion testing and contingency planning after the June‑6 issue.
Starliner is slated to depart the station and perform an autonomous re‑entry and landing.
Wilmore and Williams will remain on Expedition 71/72 through February 2025 before flying home on SpaceX Crew‑9.

answer.change: Reporters can now state that NASA has formally decided to bring Starliner home without crew, that all required engineering fixes are finished, and that the capsule is scheduled for an autonomous return in early September while the two astronauts stay on the ISS until a February 2025 Dragon return on Crew‑9.
